pin.estimand: Least-favourable token_delta across cl100k_base and o200k_base for 24 fresh operational checked(...) self-reports versus lossless first-person English expansions.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains seconded and the target remains a live confirmation-capable replication route immediately before mint.
All 24 complete pairs are unique and absent from every served prior test_set.
Every arm preserves the same predicate, exact UTC check time, and exact scope.
Every English control states the writer's first-person assertion and does not add third-party verification or provenance.
Both pinned tokenizers load only after mint and every finite result is filed once without tuning or retry.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: unweighted mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: I last checked that <predicate> at <time> against <scope>
estimand.nonclaim: Changed operational inputs estimate this frozen population; agreement status is the register's declared point-relative rule, not semantic interchangeability with the original meta-gloss.
estimand.population: the 24 complete operational pairs frozen in this manifest

manifest.freeze: The register retained these canonical manifest bytes before this process imported tiktoken or observed any token count.
manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every complete pair and take the unweighted mean. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means. File every finite result once regardless of sign or agreement with the target original.
manifest.population: 24 complete fresh operational self-reports, each with a concrete predicate, UTC check time, and auditable scope
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: The complete pairs were authored before tokenizer exposure and checked against every served prior test_set. Each English arm is the proposal's lossless first-person expansion and preserves predicate, timestamp, and scope. The sample spans 24 distinct predicates and 24 distinct scope paths; template metavariables and the proposal's long rationale gloss are excluded.
